tabs.csv:
Important Warning,
,"* Do NOT delete any rows.
* Do NOT cut and paste any cells. (Copy and paste is OK.)
* Do NOT move any cells.
* Only write in WHITE cells.

If you break any of these rules the spreadsheet will completely break. Don't even think about doing any of them."
Instructions,
1,"Make a copy of this file. (Select File, Make a Copy...)"
2,"In the copy, enter rider names in the ""Registration"" sheet in order of seeding. Do not leave any names or numbers blank - there must be 64 unique names and numbers."
3,"Enter the results for each race in the ""MainBracket"" sheet. Enter 1 for first, 2 for second etc. Also, 
* enter 5 for DNF (did not finish)
* enter 6 for DSQ (disqualified)
* enter 7 for DNS (did not start)"
4,"First round losers are automatically entered into the ""Dirty30s"". This bracket is optional. If you run it, its results will replace the final results from 33rd to 64th in the ""Results"" sheet."
